name: coding-write-unit-tests
description: Testing: write unit tests for a validator module covering normal and edge cases

turns.userMessage: Write unit tests for all public functions in `src/validator.ts`. Cover normal paths AND edge cases: empty data, missing fields, null values, boundary values, and multiple validation failures.

mockResponses.text: Created `src/validator.test.ts` with comprehensive tests: (1) `validate` — normal path, empty data, null/undefined values, multiple errors, (2) `required` — empty string, null, non-empty, number 0, (3) `minLength` — short, exact, longer, non-string, (4) `isEmail` — valid, missing @, missing domain, empty, non-string. All edge cases covered.
